lead: A split button: the main action on the left, joined to an arrow button on the right that opens more related actions (antd's `Dropdown.Button`). It is put together with ButtonGroup, and the menu is a Menu: arrow keys, first-letter jumps and Esc to close all come from Base UI.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.composed: SplitButton is ButtonGroup + Button + Menu and has no slot of its own: its look comes from the theme styles of those three (seam corners, overlapping borders, the menu popup)
